name: niche-hunter-desktop
description: Collect research evidence and create Niche Hunter reports in Claude Desktop on Apple silicon Macs.

youtube_key.title: YouTube Data API v3 key
youtube_key.description: Required for live YouTube video and comment collection.

serpapi_key.title: SerpApi API key
serpapi_key.description: Required for live YouTube Search interest through SerpApi.

meta_token.title: Meta Ad Library access token
meta_token.description: Required for live Meta Ad Library collection.

reddit_token.title: Reddit OAuth access token
reddit_token.description: Read access token for an approved Reddit Data API connection.

reddit_user_agent.title: Reddit API User-Agent
reddit_user_agent.description: Identify your approved app using Reddit's platform:app-id:version (by /u/username) format.

reddit_approved.title: Reddit access approved
reddit_approved.description: Enable only if your Reddit approval covers this use, AI processing and retention.

tokconnect_credits_per_run.title: TokConnect credits per run
tokconnect_credits_per_run.description: Optional override. Default: 1 per run. Zero disables live TikTok.

serpapi_searches_per_run.title: SerpApi searches per run
serpapi_searches_per_run.description: Optional override. Default: 1 per run. Zero disables live YouTube.

youtube_search_calls_per_run.title: YouTube search calls per run
youtube_search_calls_per_run.description: Optional override. Default: 1 per run. Zero disables live YouTube.

youtube_comment_units_per_run.title: YouTube comment units per run
youtube_comment_units_per_run.description: Optional override. Default: up to 6 comment requests per run. Zero disables live YouTube.

tools.name: niche_hunter_status
tools.description: Check selected provider configuration without making network requests.

tools.name: niche_hunter_collect
tools.description: Collect bounded research evidence for a single run.

tools.name: niche_hunter_finalize
tools.description: Validate evidence-linked analysis and save Markdown and PDF reports.
